top_news.title: MicroLLM lab - tiny LLMs, Q4, in your browser
top_news.dek: MicroLLM lab enables running and benchmarking small language models directly in the browser using WebGPU.
top_news.brief: The tool allows developers to execute 25M–360M parameter models locally without server costs or data privacy concerns. By leveraging WebGPU, it provides an efficient edge layer for tasks like intent extraction and query filtering, reducing the need for cloud-based LLM calls.
top_news.image_alt: Web interface showing small language model benchmarks in a browser

top_news.title: OMP-MoE: Efficient Expert Pruning for Mixture-of-Experts LLMs via Orthogonal Matching Pursuit
top_news.dek: OMP-MoE is a training-free compression framework that prunes redundant experts in Mixture-of-Experts models.
top_news.brief: The method treats expert pruning as a sparse signal reconstruction task using Orthogonal Matching Pursuit. By analyzing expert contribution patterns, it reduces memory requirements without the high search costs associated with traditional pruning techniques.
top_news.image_alt: Diagram illustrating sparse signal reconstruction in MoE architectures

top_news.title: OpenAI reopens its $200 Pro plan but cuts API credits in half as it nudges users toward pay-per-use
top_news.dek: OpenAI has reopened its $200 Pro subscription while simultaneously halving the included API credits.
top_news.brief: The adjustment reflects a broader shift toward usage-based billing. OpenAI suggests that increased efficiency from newer models like GPT-6 Sol and Luna offsets the reduction in credit volume for subscribers.
top_news.image_alt: OpenAI logo and subscription pricing interface

top_news.title: Towards safety cases for frontier AI training
top_news.dek: OpenAI is developing a framework for 'safety cases' to document risks before initiating frontier AI training runs.
top_news.brief: Inspired by safety-critical industries like aviation, these guidelines aim to provide structured, evidence-based arguments regarding model safety. The initiative seeks to address the challenges of managing emergent complexity in frontier reinforcement learning.
top_news.image_alt: Conceptual graphic representing AI safety documentation

top_news.title: Browser Run - Connect multiple clients to one Browser Run session
top_news.dek: Cloudflare Browser Run now supports multiple concurrent connections to a single browser session.
top_news.brief: Previously limited to one connection, Browser Run now allows multiple Workers to connect simultaneously via puppeteer.connect(). Developers can maintain isolation between clients by creating separate browser contexts for each request.
top_news.image_alt: Cloudflare Browser Run architecture diagram showing multiple concurrent connections

primary.summary: Google Cloud AI Research has open-sourced RRSI, a framework that lets LLM agents rewrite their own prompts, tools and memory while model weights stay frozen. It adds a leakage critic, a noise floor, a cost rule and pruning so gains carry over to new tasks. With Claude Opus 4.8, Terminal-Bench 2.1 rose from 74.2% to 80.2%, and all 6 held-out splits improved.
